title: WALLOP
description:
WALLOP is a fast, replayable 3D bullet-heaven roguelike. You're the Pizza Hero, last delivery on Earth, fighting through endless swarms of food-themed monsters. Your weapons fire on their own — you focus on movement, dodging, and the choices that turn a shaky start into screen-clearing carnage.

AUTO-COMBAT, BIG CHOICESPosition and dodge while your arsenal fires automatically. Every level-up is a fresh pick — stack pizza tosses, orbiting wheels, chain lightning, fireballs, ice cones and more into a build that snowballs out of control.

GEAR UPA dozen weapons plus armor and tomes to mix and match. Hunt for synergies, evolve your kit, and watch the horde melt.

PLAY YOUR WAYSix heroes, each with a unique starter weapon and playstyle — the balanced Pizza Hero, icy Frost Baker, tanky Oven Knight, speedy Crust Runner, sharpshooting Anchovy Archer, and elusive Stealth Slice.

ARENAS & BOSSESThree distinct arenas, each with its own look and three escalating boss tiers — from the Sauce Slinger to the final Warlord. Clear an arena to unlock the next.

CHALLENGES12 handcrafted challenge runs with twists — glass-cannon runs, speed kills, no-damage survival, and character-specific gauntlets.

PERMANENT PROGRESSIONEarn Slices and unlock characters, weapons, and permanent boosts. Every run makes the next one stronger.

PREMIUM ON STEAMNo ads. No microtransactions. No pay-to-win. Buy it once, unlock everything by playing — that's the deal.

Smash. Survive. Snowball.
description_short: A 3D bullet-heaven roguelike: you're the Pizza Hero, smashing endless swarms of food-monsters. Auto-fight, dodge, level up, and snowball one chaotic run into an unstoppable build. No ads, no purchases — just pure "one more run."
